items.stem: What was the woman's problem?

choices.text: She was pierced by a chicken bone.
She was coughing all the time.
She suffered from lung cancer.
She suffered from shock.

items.stem: How was the woman's problem eventually solved?

choices.text: By eating chicken soup daily.
Through regular exercising.
Through a surgical operation.
By using traditional Chinese medicine.

items.stem: What does the news report say about the white sheep Prickles?

choices.text: It was born 13 years ago.
It was Alice Gray's lovely pet.
It got injured in a big bushfire.
choices.zh: 它在一场大型丛林火灾中受伤。

choices.text: It ran away into a nearby forest.

items.stem: What did the family do after the bushfires?

choices.text: They rebuilt the fencing around their farm.
choices.zh: 他们重建了农场周围的围栏。

choices.text: They spent seven years replanting their farm.
choices.zh: 他们花了七年时间重新种植农场。

choices.text: They claimed damages for their heavy losses.
They installed a camera to monitor sheep activity.
choices.zh: 他们安装了摄像头来监控羊的活动。

items.stem: What is the news report mainly about?

choices.text: The disappearance of some gold and diamonds.
choices.zh: 一些黄金和钻石的失踪。

choices.text: The transfer of tons of precious metal by air.
The crash of a Russian cargo airplane.
choices.zh: 一架俄罗斯货机的坠毁。

choices.text: The loss of gold from an airplane.

items.stem: What did the aircraft do when the incident happened?

choices.text: It made an emergency landing.
It informed the local police at once.
choices.zh: 它立即通知了当地警方。

choices.text: It contacted the goldmine company.
It had a crew member fix the problem.
choices.zh: 它让一名机组人员修理了问题。

items.stem: What does the news report say about the technical engineers who worked on the plane before take-off?

choices.text: They will cooperate with the police.
They had checked the plane carefully.
choices.zh: 他们曾仔细检查过飞机。

choices.text: They will be questioned by the police.
They took some gold bars and diamonds.
choices.zh: 他们拿走了一些金条和钻石。

items.stem: Why does the man have his conversation with the woman recorded?

choices.text: For the company's records.
For future training purposes.
To follow the company's rule.
To ensure information security.

items.stem: What is the woman's purpose of calling the furniture company?

choices.text: To check her customer reference number.
choices.zh: 核查她的客户参考编号。

choices.text: To inquire about the price of office chairs.
To get her money back for the returned chair.
choices.zh: 为退回的椅子拿回她的钱。

choices.text: To make complaints about its customer service.
choices.zh: 对其客户服务进行投诉。

items.stem: What does the woman say about her bank card?

choices.text: She had to update its information.
She forgot where she had left it.
choices.zh: 她忘记把它落在哪里了。

choices.text: She lost it about three days ago.
choices.zh: 她大约三天前丢失了它。

choices.text: She was issued a new card.

items.stem: What does the man advise the woman to do?

choices.text: Reconsider her options for payment methods.
choices.zh: 重新考虑她的支付方式选项。

choices.text: Make a specific note on the company's system.
choices.zh: 在公司的系统上做一个具体备注。

choices.text: Update her bank card details on the company's website.
choices.zh: 在公司的网站上更新她的银行卡详细信息。

choices.text: Upload her personal information to the company's website.
choices.zh: 将她的个人信息上传到公司的网站。

items.stem: Why isn't the man going to cook?

choices.text: He is feeling exhausted.
He is tired of cooking.
He has to work late.
He wants to try Asian foods.

items.stem: What does the man say he'll do on his phone?

choices.text: Book a table.
Order a delivery.
Download a menu.
Locate a restaurant.

items.stem: What does the woman think of Indian food?

choices.text: It is not tasty.
It is not healthy.
It is too oily.
It is too spicy.

items.stem: What does the man think of the woman?

choices.text: She is too concerned about money.
She is too weight-conscious.
She is too picky about food.
She is too eager to please.

items.stem: What do we learn from the new study by the University of Lincoln?

choices.text: Owners' personalities affect their cats' behaviour and wellbeing.
choices.zh: 主人的性格会影响他们的猫的行为和健康状况。

choices.text: Parents' personalities can affect the personalities of their children.
choices.zh: 父母的性格会影响他们孩子的性格。

choices.text: Parents and cat owners alike experience high levels of anxiety.
choices.zh: 父母和养猫者都经历高度焦虑。

choices.text: More and more people are treating pet cats like their children.
choices.zh: 越来越多的人像对待孩子一样对待宠物猫。

items.stem: What does the passage say most pet owners want to do?

choices.text: Give their pets behavioural training.
choices.zh: 给他们的宠物进行行为训练。

choices.text: Provide their pets with the best care.
choices.zh: 为他们的宠物提供最好的照顾。

choices.text: Know their pets' feelings and desires.
choices.zh: 了解他们宠物的感受和愿望。

choices.text: Interact with their pets in novel ways.
choices.zh: 以新颖的方式与他们的宠物互动。

items.stem: What does the passage say is still needed to understand the effects of owners' personalities on their pets?

choices.text: More convincing explanation.
More extensive sampling.
Collection of more data.
Further investigation.

items.stem: What did the new review of studies claim?

choices.text: People should do more running than mere walking.
choices.zh: 人们应该多跑步而不是仅仅走路。

choices.text: Running is the best exercise for extending one's life.
choices.zh: 跑步是延长寿命的最佳运动。

choices.text: People should exercise at least 60 minutes every day.
choices.zh: 人们每天至少应该运动60分钟。

choices.text: Running is the easiest form of exercise for most people.
choices.zh: 跑步是对大多数人来说最容易的运动形式。

items.stem: What is one effect that running has on people according to recent research?

choices.text: Improving their brain function.
Regulating their breathing rate.
Slowing down their ageing process.
Accelerating their blood circulation.

items.stem: What did another study find about the participants after they had a 30-minute jog?

choices.text: They found it easy to control their emotions.
choices.zh: 他们发现控制情绪变得容易了。

choices.text: They struggled to handle negative emotions.
choices.zh: 他们难以处理负面情绪。

choices.text: They were more eager to enjoy a movie.
They were less affected by sad movies.
choices.zh: 他们受悲伤电影的影响更小。

items.stem: What do we learn about the speaker?

choices.text: He is a tour guide.
He is a famous architect.
He is a local entrepreneur.
He is the owner of the Hill House.

items.stem: What did the architect do before beginning his design?

choices.text: He studied the blueprints of other famous buildings.
choices.zh: 他研究了其他著名建筑的蓝图。

choices.text: He inquired about his client's family background.
choices.zh: 他询问了客户的家庭背景。

choices.text: He observed his client's life and habits.
choices.zh: 他观察了客户的生活和习惯。

choices.text: He took a tour of his client's old home.

items.stem: What did the architect's client mainly want?

choices.text: A house made of timber and brick.
choices.zh: 一座木材和砖砌的房子。

choices.text: A house with a lot of free space.
choices.zh: 一座有大量自由空间的房子。

choices.text: A house of the current fashion.
choices.zh: 一座符合当前时尚的房子。

choices.text: A house of a unique design.

items.stem: What do we learn about the pieces of furniture in the children's bedrooms?

choices.text: They are well preserved and in pretty good shape.
choices.zh: 它们保存完好,状况相当不错。

choices.text: They are copies built to the architect's designs.
choices.zh: 它们是按照建筑师的设计建造的复制品。

choices.text: They were designed by another architect.
choices.zh: 它们由另一位建筑师设计。

choices.text: They were badly damaged but restored.
choices.zh: 它们曾严重损坏但已修复。
